title: iewa-electronic-1997-world-womens-heavyweight
label: Napualokelani

won.source: An open invitational battle royal to crown the first titleholder was announced for the 27 October 1997 Monday Night Mania in the fed's own title update of 21 October 1997; Napualokelani is billed as champion by the 8 December 1997 broadcast and retained by disqualification against Jessica Starbird in the result the fed posted on 19 December 1997.

note: Retained against Jessica Starbird by disqualification on Monday Night Mania, 8 December 1997, after throwing salt in her challenger's face; GDWA's own World Champion ran in afterward to raise Starbird's hand. An earlier record briefly filed the same 19 December 1997 result under a separate title, "IEWA Women's TV Championship," attributed to an unrelated promotion; no such title survives in the record under any promotion, and this reign is the sole surviving account of the battle royal's outcome.

title: iewa-electronic-1997-television
label: Sledgeman

won.source: Already billed champion on the broadcast of Monday Night Mania, 8 December 1997; the reign's own start is not established in the surviving record.

note: Retained against former champion Richard Starr on Monday Night Mania, 8 December 1997, when interference from both men's own allies produced a double disqualification.

title: iewa-electronic-1997-world-tag-team
label: Hysteria

won.source: Already billed champions on the broadcast of Monday Night Mania, 8 December 1997, which recaps them as having 'regained the tag straps' from Japan Connection; neither title change is independently dated in the surviving record.

note: Challenged the debuting Disciples of Rage to a cage match on the same broadcast after Japan Connection lost to the Disciples in a non-title match.

title: iewa-electronic-1997-womens-skyweight
label: Jun Shiratori

won.source: Already billed champion on the broadcast of Monday Night Mania, 8 December 1997; the reign's own start is not established in the surviving record.

note: Used her own title belt as a weapon against Jessica Starbird during a pre-match brawl on Monday Night Mania, 8 December 1997; no on-camera defense is recorded in this pass's holdings.

title: iewa-electronic-1997-womens-intercontinental
label: Jessica Starbird

won.source: Won from Rekka Sakura at an unspecified date before the fed's own Countdown Extra broadcast, 27 April 1998; Starbird's own on-air account does not give the date or the show.

note: Already billed champion on the broadcast of Countdown Extra, 27 April 1998, where Starbird calls this win over Rekka Sakura her first title, separate from an earlier match for a 'now defunct' television title she says she does not remember.

title: iewa-electronic-1997-womens-tag-team
label: Prima Donnas

won.source: Already billed champions on the broadcast of Countdown Extra, 27 April 1998; the reign's own start is not established in the surviving record.

note: Held through the fed's own spring 1998 hiatus, with an upcoming Texas Tornado match against the Misfits and a pay-per-view title defense both referenced on Countdown Extra, 27 April 1998.
